displayName: Triage the week ahead and flag conflicts
summary: Scan your upcoming calendar and surface anything that needs attention before it happens.

useCases.title: Triage the week ahead and flag conflicts
useCases.message: Help me triage my week ahead. If you don't already know, ask me which calendar to check. Then scan the next 7 days for conflicts, back-to-back meetings, anything without an agenda, and anything that needs prep. Flag anything I should act on before it arrives.
